home.seoDesc: Run your family njangi, contributions and meetings — all in one place. Kinsroot tracks savings, loans, assistance and attendance in one platform.
home.badge: Built for African families · Works offline
home.sub: Kinsroot gives your family one shared home for meetings, contributions, njangi, loans and support — clear for everyone, even offline.
home.privacy: Private to your family. Every record visible to the people who should see it.

platform.title: Everything a family association runs on, in one calm place.
platform.meetingsDesc: Plan the whole year of hosting in one go, build the agenda, check members in by QR, and let lateness fines and minutes follow automatically.
platform.njangiD: Ballot the payout order and track every round.
platform.loansD: Committee review, interest and deadlines built in.
platform.supportD: Births, bereavement, sickness and joyful events — handled with care and clear rules.
platform.paymentsD: MTN & Orange proofs reviewed before they reach the ledger.

prosperity.title: Every contribution tells a story.
prosperity.body: A house levy, a njangi round, a gift for a newborn. Kinsroot keeps each one with its receipt and its reason, so the family’s growth is something everyone can see — and trust.

how.title: Up and running in an afternoon.
how.d1: Name it, choose your currency and invite members by link or QR.
how.d2: Head, treasurer, secretary, committee — each sees what they need.
how.d3: Agenda, check-in, contributions and minutes, all recorded together.
